purpose: Preserve baseline bottleneck evidence and first optimized palette benchmark. The final source has a subsequent context-mode cache invalidation fix; the project owner will perform final relink and acceptance benchmarks.

case_inputs.motion: camera orbit and computed history year scrub

baseline_profile.display: Wayland (actual selected backend: inherited WAYLAND_DISPLAY remained set despite DISPLAY=:0)
baseline_profile.diagnosis: Repeated color-only fluence rebuild uploaded/recreated the full 757719-vertex buffer and regenerated the world-reference grid. Plot scans/traces were below 0.9 ms/frame and were not the limiting phase.
baseline_profile.profile_source: temporary FARIS_FRAME_PROFILE instrumentation; removed from final source

optimized_palette_profile.scope: same four exact corrected fine records, assumptions, field, camera/year motion, size and graphics adapter; component geometry was cached by Arc identity and six per-component color/camera uniforms replaced the per-vertex color map/upload. The subsequent context-mode invalidation fix only affects transitions between renderer modes and does not change this continuous component-fluence path.
optimized_palette_profile.profile_source: temporary FARIS_FRAME_PROFILE instrumentation; removed from final source

retained_profile_counters.limitation: Linux perf_event_paranoid=4 blocked CPU sampling events; perf stat reports elapsed/user/sys only. UI timers captured viewport prepare and plot phases directly.

qualification_boundary: Egui frame-throughput measurement, not GPU-presented FPS. The optimized benchmark passed the 30 FPS threshold in a short X11 sample; the final context-mode-fixed release binary still requires owner relink and acceptance benchmark. The baseline and optimized entries differ in display backend/scaling and must not be used as a controlled ratio.
